<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>日落沙漠 · 商务演示</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Open+Sans:wght@300;400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
    <style>
        /* ===== 全局重置 & 基础 ===== */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        body {
            background: #0e0a17;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--color-text);
            overflow: hidden;
            user-select: none;
        }

        :root {
            --color-background: #2C1E16;
            --color-text: #F5F5DC;
            --color-text-muted: #C9A96E;
            --color-primary: #E67E22;
            --color-secondary: #8B4513;
            --color-accent: #FF8C00;
            --color-card: #482E1C;
            --color-surface: #3A2518;
            --font-body: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-heading: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
        }

        /* ===== 幻灯片容器 ===== */
        .slides-wrapper {
            width: 1280px;
            height: 720px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 18px;
            box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 0 1px rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.12);
            position: relative;
            background: var(--color-background);
        }

        .slides-track {
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        /* ===== 幻灯片通用 ===== */
        .slide {
            flex: 0 0 1280px;
            width: 1280px;
            height: 720px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: var(--color-background);
        }

        /* ===== 装饰：沙丘（底部） ===== */
        .decor-dunes {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 140px;
            z-index: 1;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.55;
        }
        .decor-dunes svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: block;
        }

        /* ===== 装饰：太阳（右上） ===== */
        .decor-sun {
            position: absolute;
            top: 30px;
            right: 40px;
            z-index: 2;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.70;
        }
        .decor-sun svg {
            width: 90px;
            height: 90px;
            display: block;
        }

        /* ===== 装饰：星星/光点 ===== */
        .decor-stars {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .decor-stars span {
            position: absolute;
            display: block;
            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;
            background: #C9A96E;
            border-radius: 50%;
            opacity: 0.3;
            animation: twinkle 3s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
        }
        .decor-stars span:nth-child(1) {
            top: 12%;
            left: 8%;
            width: 2px;
            height: 2px;
            opacity: 0.25;
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }
        .decor-stars span:nth-child(2) {
            top: 18%;
            left: 22%;
            width: 4px;
            height: 4px;
            opacity: 0.35;
            animation-delay: 0.8s;
        }
        .decor-stars span:nth-child(3) {
            top: 5%;
            left: 45%;
            width: 2px;
            height: 2px;
            opacity: 0.2;
            animation-delay: 1.6s;
        }
        .decor-stars span:nth-child(4) {
            top: 25%;
            left: 70%;
            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;
            opacity: 0.3;
            animation-delay: 0.4s;
        }
        .decor-stars span:nth-child(5) {
            top: 8%;
            left: 88%;
            width: 2px;
            height: 2px;
            opacity: 0.2;
            animation-delay: 2.2s;
        }
        .decor-stars span:nth-child(6) {
            top: 32%;
            left: 55%;
            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;
            opacity: 0.25;
            animation-delay: 1.2s;
        }

        @keyframes twinkle {
            0% {
                opacity: 0.15;
                transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 0.55;
                transform: scale(1.2);
            }
        }

        /* ===== 装饰：沙金分割线 ===== */
        .divider-line {
            position: absolute;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #C9A96E, transparent);
            opacity: 0.35;
            z-index: 3;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===== 页面标题（绝对定位） ===== */
        .page-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 40px;
            left: 60px;
            z-index: 10;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 16px;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            background: rgba(230, 126, 34, 0.12);
            padding: 6px 18px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(230, 126, 34, 0.20);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }

        /* ===== 页面内容区域（绝对定位） ===== */
        .page-content {
            position: absolute;
            top: 130px;
            left: 60px;
            right: 60px;
            bottom: 70px;
            z-index: 10;
            
            
            
            
            
            overflow-y: auto;
            color: var(--color-text);
        }

        /* ===== 页脚 ===== */
        .slide-footer {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 18px;
            right: 60px;
            z-index: 20;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            opacity: 0.6;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .slide-footer .page-num {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        /* ================================================================
                   页面类型专属样式
                   ================================================================ */

        /* ---- cover 封面 ---- */
        .slide.cover .main-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 200px;
            left: 80px;
            z-index: 10;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 58px;
            color: #FFFFFF;
            line-height: 1.2;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }
        .slide.cover .main-title .highlight {
            color: var(--color-primary);
        }
        .slide.cover .subtitle {
            position: absolute;
            top: 310px;
            left: 80px;
            z-index: 10;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        }
        .slide.cover .date-badge {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 100px;
            left: 80px;
            z-index: 10;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--color-accent);
            background: rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.12);
            padding: 10px 28px;
            border-radius: 40px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.25);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        .slide.cover .cover-sub {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 100px;
            left: 260px;
            z-index: 10;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            opacity: 0.6;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        /* ---- toc 目录 ---- */
        .slide.toc .page-content {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 18px;
            
            
            
        }
        .toc-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 24px;
            padding: 14px 20px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--color-primary);
            transition: background 0.3s;
        }
        .toc-item:hover {
            background: rgba(230, 126, 34, 0.08);
        }
        .toc-item .toc-num {
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 28px;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            opacity: 0.6;
            min-width: 48px;
        }
        .toc-item .toc-text {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 400;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--color-text);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .toc-item .toc-desc {
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            opacity: 0.7;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        /* ---- section 章节 ---- */
        .slide.section .section-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 200px;
            left: 80px;
            z-index: 10;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #FFFFFF;
            line-height: 1.3;
            max-width: 80%;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        }
        .slide.section .subtitle {
            position: absolute;
            top: 310px;
            left: 80px;
            z-index: 10;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            max-width: 60%;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }
        .slide.section .section-decor-line {
            position: absolute;
            top: 175px;
            left: 80px;
            width: 70px;
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--color-primary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            z-index: 10;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(230, 126, 34, 0.3);
        }

        /* ---- content 内容 ---- */
        .slide.content .page-content {
            /* 只保留样式，内部仅有  占位符 */
            
            
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            opacity: 0.5;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            min-height: 240px;
        }
        /* 注意：.page-content 内部只有  文本，没有其他元素 */

        /* ---- ending 结尾 ---- */
        .slide.ending .ending-content {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 10;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
        }
        .slide.ending .ending-content h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 56px;
            color: #FFFFFF;
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-shadow: 0 4px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .slide.ending .ending-content .ending-message {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            opacity: 0.8;
        }
        .slide.ending .ending-content .ending-icon {
            font-size: 48px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        /* ===== 导航点 ===== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 22px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            z-index: 100;
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.25);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.10);
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            transform: scale(1.25);
            border-color: var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(230, 126, 34, 0.35);
        }
        .nav-dot:hover {
            background: rgba(230, 126, 34, 0.4);
        }

        /* ===== 导航箭头 ===== */
        .nav-arrows {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 100;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 20px;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .nav-arrow {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(44, 30, 22, 0.70);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.15);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            pointer-events: auto;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            opacity: 0.5;
        }
        .nav-arrow:hover {
            opacity: 1;
            background: rgba(230, 126, 34, 0.25);
            border-color: var(--color-primary);
            color: var(--color-primary);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        /* ===== 页码指示器 ===== */
        .page-indicator {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 20px;
            right: 80px;
            z-index: 80;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            opacity: 0.5;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        .page-indicator .current {
            color: var(--color-primary);
            opacity: 0.9;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        /* ===== 滚动条美化 ===== */
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
        }
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.05);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        /* ===== 响应式辅助 ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1300px) {
            .slides-wrapper {
                width: 100vw;
                height: 56.25vw;
                max-height: 100vh;
                border-radius: 0;
            }
            .slide {
                width: 100vw;
                height: 56.25vw;
                max-height: 100vh;
            }
            .slide.cover .main-title {
                font-size: 4.2vw;
                top: 16vw;
                left: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.cover .subtitle {
                font-size: 1.8vw;
                top: 24vw;
                left: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.cover .date-badge {
                font-size: 1.4vw;
                padding: 0.8vw 2.2vw;
                bottom: 8vw;
                left: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.cover .cover-sub {
                font-size: 1.2vw;
                bottom: 8vw;
                left: 20vw;
            }
            .page-title {
                font-size: 1.3vw;
                top: 3vw;
                left: 4.5vw;
                padding: 0.4vw 1.4vw;
            }
            .page-content {
                top: 10vw;
                left: 4.5vw;
                right: 4.5vw;
                bottom: 6vw;
                
                font-size: 1.4vw;
            }
            .slide.section .section-title {
                font-size: 3.8vw;
                top: 16vw;
                left: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.section .subtitle {
                font-size: 1.6vw;
                top: 24vw;
                left: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.section .section-decor-line {
                top: 14vw;
                left: 6vw;
                width: 5.5vw;
                height: 0.35vw;
            }
            .slide.ending .ending-content h1 {
                font-size: 4.4vw;
            }
            .slide.ending .ending-content .ending-message {
                font-size: 2vw;
            }
            .toc-item .toc-num {
                font-size: 2.2vw;
                min-width: 4vw;
            }
            .toc-item .toc-text {
                font-size: 1.6vw;
            }
            .toc-item .toc-desc {
                font-size: 1.2vw;
            }
            .decor-sun svg {
                width: 7vw;
                height: 7vw;
            }
            .decor-dunes {
                height: 11vw;
            }
            .nav-arrow {
                width: 3.4vw;
                height: 3.4vw;
                font-size: 1.4vw;
            }
            .nav-dot {
                width: 0.8vw;
                height: 0.8vw;
            }
            .page-indicator {
                font-size: 1.2vw;
                right: 6vw;
                bottom: 1.6vw;
            }
            .page-indicator .current {
                font-size: 1.6vw;
            }
            .slide-footer {
                font-size: 1vw;
                right: 4.5vw;
                bottom: 1.4vw;
            }
            .slide.cover .main-title .highlight {
                font-size: inherit;
            }
            .decor-stars span {
                width: 0.2vw;
                height: 0.2vw;
            }
            .decor-stars span:nth-child(1) {
                width: 0.15vw;
                height: 0.15vw;
            }
            .decor-stars span:nth-child(2) {
                width: 0.3vw;
                height: 0.3vw;
            }
            .decor-stars span:nth-child(3) {
                width: 0.15vw;
                height: 0.15vw;
            }
            .decor-stars span:nth-child(4) {
                width: 0.2vw;
                height: 0.2vw;
            }
            .decor-stars span:nth-child(5) {
                width: 0.15vw;
                height: 0.15vw;
            }
            .decor-stars span:nth-child(6) {
                width: 0.2vw;
                height: 0.2vw;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .nav-arrows {
                display: none;
            }
            .slide.cover .main-title {
                font-size: 5.5vw;
                top: 18vw;
            }
            .slide.cover .subtitle {
                font-size: 2.4vw;
                top: 27vw;
            }
            .slide.cover .date-badge {
                font-size: 2vw;
                padding: 1.2vw 3vw;
            }
            .page-title {
                font-size: 2vw;
                top: 4vw;

            }
            .page-content {
                top: 12vw;

                right: 5vw;
                bottom: 8vw;
                
                font-size: 2vw;
            }
            .slide.section .section-title {
                font-size: 5vw;
                top: 18vw;
                left: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.section .subtitle {
                font-size: 2.4vw;
                top: 27vw;
                left: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.ending .ending-content h1 {
                font-size: 6vw;
            }
            .slide.ending .ending-content .ending-message {
                font-size: 3vw;
            }
            .toc-item .toc-num {
                font-size: 3vw;
                min-width: 6vw;
            }
            .toc-item .toc-text {
                font-size: 2.4vw;
            }
            .toc-item .toc-desc {
                font-size: 1.8vw;
            }
            .decor-sun svg {
                width: 10vw;
                height: 10vw;
            }
            .decor-dunes {
                height: 14vw;
            }

                height: 1.2vw;
            }
            .page-indicator {

            }
            .page-indicator .current {
                font-size: 2.2vw;
            }
            .slide-footer {
                font-size: 1.6vw;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- ===== 幻灯片外层 ===== -->
    <div class="slides-wrapper" id="slidesWrapper">
        <div class="slides-track" id="slidesTrack">

            <!-- ========== 1. 封面页 cover ========== -->
            <div class="slide cover">
                <!-- 装饰：星星 -->
                <div class="decor-stars">
                    <span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span>
                </div>
                <!-- 装饰：太阳 -->
                <div class="decor-sun">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                        <defs>
                            <radialGradient id="sunGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
                                <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFB347" />
                                <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#E67E22" />
                                <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8B4513" stop-opacity="0" />
                            </radialGradient>
                            <filter id="sunGlow">
                                <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur" />
                                <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur" /><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" /></feMerge>
                            </filter>
                        </defs>
                        <!-- 放射线 -->
                        <g stroke="#C9A96E" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.35" transform="translate(50,50)">
                            <line x1="0" y1="-38" x2="0" y2="-58" />
                            <line x1="27" y1="-27" x2="41" y2="-41" />
                            <line x1="38" y1="0" x2="58" y2="0" />
                            <line x1="27" y1="27" x2="41" y2="41" />
                            <line x1="-27" y1="-27" x2="-41" y2="-41" />

    <script>
        // ===== 幻灯片导航逻辑 =====
        (function() {
            const track = document.getElementById('slidesTrack');
            const slides = track.querySelectorAll('.slide');
            const totalSlides = slides.length;
            let currentIndex = 0;

            // 更新 totalPages 显示
            document.getElementById('totalPages').textContent = totalSlides;

            // 动态创建导航点
            const navDots = document.getElementById('navDots');
            for (let i = 0; i < totalSlides; i++) {
                const dot = document.createElement('div');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.onclick = (function(idx) {
                    return function() { goToSlide(idx); };
                })(i);
                navDots.appendChild(dot);
            }

            const dots = navDots.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');

            function goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0) index = 0;
                if (index >= totalSlides) index = totalSlides - 1;
                currentIndex = index;
                // 滑动切换
                track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-currentIndex * 1280) + 'px)';
                // 更新导航点
                dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
                    d.classList.toggle('active', i === currentIndex);
                });
                // 更新页码
                document.getElementById('currentPage').textContent = currentIndex + 1;
            }

            // 暴露到全局
            window.goToSlide = goToSlide;
            window.nextSlide = function() { goToSlide(currentIndex + 1); };
            window.prevSlide = function() { goToSlide(currentIndex - 1); };

            // 键盘导航
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    window.nextSlide();
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    window.prevSlide();
                }
            });

            // 触摸滑动支持
            let touchStartX = 0;
            let touchEndX = 0;
            const wrapper = document.getElementById('slidesWrapper');
            wrapper.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
            }, { passive: true });
            wrapper.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
                touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
                const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
                if (Math.abs(diff) > 40) {
                    if (diff > 0) window.nextSlide();
                    else window.prevSlide();
                }
            }, { passive: true });

            // 初始化
            goToSlide(0);
        })();
    </script>
